how: Members call fellow vault hunters to band together and leave a recognizable mark.
Members compare existing symbols and challenge the proposed scale while discussing what their mark should look like.
Individual members report starting a Psycho and building a Claptrap outline after its wheel disappeared.
The opening proposal supplies a pixelated target and an anchor coordinate rather than waiting for an agreed design.
A completion claim immediately names an alteration into an A and calls for repair.
A proposed Psycho design receives a member's explicit report of starting that picture.
The Psycho builder answers a design proposal with a short report of action and coordinates without asking anything back.
Approval of a moonbase proposal is qualified by the stated lack of space.
Members carry recognizable game lines into a reply chain without reporting that those lines were placed on the canvas.
The Japan title supplies a call to overtake another work without demonstrating that an attack occurred.
Participants celebrate a small A-like symbol as an achievement relative to their subreddit's size.
Participants share a found mark and report where it can be located after placement ends.
The threatened-Claptrap poster attributes the encroachment to the Dutch without identifying individual placers or tracing their actions.
A theme containing a repair appeal also contains recruiting, proposing, coordinates, and celebration, so maintenance explains only the repair component.
Retrospective locating need not settle authorship or adopt another maker's mark, so finding alone cannot establish a representational decision.
Only the Japan title warrants an attack-call reading because the phase announcement specifies no target or attack action.
A hostile question and a joke about swallowed space require an explicit general canvas objection before they can establish host boundary work.
Correcting landmark names requires an actual dispute over a shared version or event account before it can establish contested preservation.
Conditional offers and qualified approval must remain distinguishable from a bare commitment to act.
Posting a template can launch a proposal before scale disagreement rather than settle a design already agreed.
A help call can receive a reason-free adverse question or joke, so written response cannot be presumed to mean joining or reasoned refusal.
Approval of a proposed extension can remain conditional on finding space without establishing either building or abandonment.
Recovering a mark's location includes asking for landmarks, supplying them, and correcting their names after placement ends.
A posted find receives surprise about its small size and then the poster's celebration, making display an occasion for celebration.

how: Dismissal and joking are locally consequential written responses even when they neither promise help nor establish host moderation or reciprocal rivalry.
